purpose: THE human decision boundary of the whole pipeline. The client picks one of the three concepts.

inputContract.notes: artifacts from the concepts lane-output, each with its revisionHash.

outputContract.notes: actor is always human_approved — recordApproval throws if anything tries to record an ai_confirmed value as an approval. revision is the sha256 of the exact approved file.

outputExample.evidence: concept shadcn approved at revision a1d961b5fcfe…

revise.effect: Drops any standing concept approval into approvalsHistory (reason concept_review_revise:<scope>), bumps the concept round, and — for scope structure — bumps the wireframe round so the structure is redone before the concepts are.
revise.notes: Not a third touchpoint: the same 시안 리뷰 happens again.

recolor.effect: Routes the concepts stage to the visual-concept-recolor pass (hue only, existing concepts are not regenerated).

decisions.cap: MAX_CONCEPT_ROUNDS = 5 (research/lib/limits.mjs maxHumanRounds). A further request is refused: the run is marked blocked with the exhaustion reason instead of looping.

handoff.via: The approved conceptId + revision drive the post-approval outputs; any later change to the concept or the PRD invalidates this approval.
